    def has_direct_return(stmts: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> bool:
        found = False
        i = 0
        n = len(stmts)
        #@ loop invariant 0 <= i and i <= n
        #@ loop variant n - i
        while i < n and not found:
            stmt = stmts[i]
            stype = stmt.get("stmt")
            if stype == "Return":
                found = True
            elif stype == "If":
                if (IRScanner.has_direct_return(stmt.get("body", [])) or
                        IRScanner.has_direct_return(stmt.get("orelse", []))):
                    found = True
            i += 1
        return found
